seo.title: Fishki — simple flashcards, smart reviews
seo.description: Create medical flashcards with text, images and cloze deletions. Study with quick review or spaced repetition.

hero.title: Simple to create. Smart to review.
hero.subtitle: Create your own flashcards with text, images and cloze deletions as quickly as in Quizlet. Study with quick review or a spaced repetition system you can trust.
hero.validation: Built from conversations with medical students using Anki and Quizlet.

mockup.front: Mechanism of action of beta blockers

comparison.heading: You should not have to choose between simplicity and effective learning.
comparison.intro: Medical students need a fast editor and a serious review system. Today's tools usually deliver only one of them.

products.name: Anki
products.label: Powerful, but complicated
products.text: Strong review algorithms, but a dated interface, difficult setup and slow creation of richer cards.

products.name: Quizlet
products.label: Simple, but limited
products.text: Pleasant and fast card creation, but too little control for demanding medical exam preparation.

products.name: Fishki
products.label: Simple creation + smart reviews
products.text: A fast editor, flexible study modes and tools for images, tables and long medical answers.

features.heading: From a quick note to a well-planned review.
features.intro: Every feature should either shorten card creation or give you better control over what you study today.

items.heading: Fast manual card creation
items.text: Text, formatting, highlights and a clean editor without complicated configuration.

items.heading: Cloze deletion
items.text: Write one note, select key terms and turn them into several fill-in-the-blank cards.

items.heading: Image-first cards
items.text: Add images to both sides. Ideal for slides, anatomy, pathology and tables.

items.heading: Image occlusion
items.text: Cover labels, diagram fragments or table cells and review them without retyping content.

items.heading: Two study modes
items.text: Spaced repetition for long-term retention or quick “I know / I don't know” sessions.

items.heading: Review order control
items.text: Study randomly, in deck order, oldest first or newest first.

items.heading: Reverse cards
items.text: Review question–answer, answer–question or both directions in the same deck.

items.heading: Session limits
items.text: Choose 20, 50 or 100 cards from a large deck and fit study into the time you have.

items.heading: Difficult card tracking
items.text: Automatically surface questions you repeatedly miss.

items.heading: Exam mode
items.text: Set an exam date and gradually intensify reviews of the most important cards.

items.heading: Offline-first learning
items.text: Download decks, study without internet and sync your progress later.

items.heading: Shared decks
items.text: Browse other students' decks or collaborate on material with your group.

useCases.heading: Medical material rarely fits into one sentence.
useCases.intro: Fishki is designed to support images, diagrams, classifications and multi-point answers without forcing them into an oversimplified format.

howItWorks.heading: A simple study rhythm without building a system from scratch.

steps.title: Create your own cards in seconds.
steps.text: Enter a question and answer, add an image or select a fragment as a cloze deletion.

steps.title: Choose quick review or spaced repetition.
steps.text: Review your way before a class or let the system schedule long-term learning.

steps.title: Track weak cards and prepare for exams.
